purpose: Define each accepted/outbound network connection as a transient runtime identity separate from peer identity, listener identity and authenticated session identity.

topics.name: Network Connection Identity
topics.purpose: Define each accepted/outbound network connection as a transient runtime identity separate from peer identity, listener identity and authenticated session identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each connection has a distinct transient connection identity.
semantics.listener_rule: Inbound connection references exact listener identity.
semantics.peer_rule: Observed remote endpoint is transport metadata, not peer semantic identity.
semantics.lifetime_rule: Open/close timestamps and state are evidence only.
semantics.authority_rule: Connection existence grants no application authority.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: remote IP used as peer identity
connection id reused as IAM session
socket fd used as canonical identity
